sample_intro: Every component from the shared UI library, in a library setting.
sample_buttons_description: One primary action per screen; everything else stays quiet.
sample_form_description: Details used to find the book in your library.
sample_form_isbn_error: This ISBN has {count} digits: enter 10 or 13.
sample_form_isbn_copy_failed: The browser did not allow copying.
sample_form_shelf_hint: Not editable: assigned by the library.
sample_form_saved: {title} has been added to the catalogue.
nav_description: Pages of the library and your account.
home_intro: Your library, kept in order like a reading room.
home_sign_in_prompt: Sign in to open your catalogue.
profile_details_description: How you appear to other readers and on your loans.
profile_display_name_hint: Your full name, or the name you prefer to be called.
profile_display_name_too_long: Shorten the display name to {max} characters or fewer.
profile_email_hint: Used to sign in. Change it in your sign-in account.
profile_save_failed: Your profile could not be saved. Try again in a moment.
profile_reading_room_description: How the library looks and speaks to you. Changes apply straight away.
profile_role_description: Your role is set by an administrator. Ask one if you need to do more in the library.
profile_role_empty: You have no role yet: you can use the library, but not manage it.
profile_early_access_description: Features still being finished, open to you before the rest of the library.
profile_security_description: Your password, sign-in methods and open sessions are kept by your sign-in account.
forbidden_title: You don’t have access to this page
forbidden_description: Your roles don’t include the permission this page needs. Ask an administrator if you need it.
users_intro: Everyone with a reader’s card: their roles, and whether they can sign in.
user_no_account: No sign-in account was found for this user: it may have been deleted.
user_details_description: How this user appears to other readers.
user_action_failed: That change could not be made. Reload the page and try again.
user_role_description_edit: Every user has one role, which sets their permissions. Choosing another role replaces it; a role can’t be taken away without giving another.
user_role_description_read_only: This user’s role and the permissions it gives.
user_role_description_self: You cannot change your own role: ask another administrator.
user_account_description: Whether this user can sign in to the library.
user_block_explain_blocked: This user is blocked and cannot sign in.
user_delete_description: Removes the sign-in account and everything kept for this user. This cannot be undone.
user_not_found_description: This user does not exist, or has been deleted.
